scope: Opt-in file API on original MyDOS media over real SIO. Five simultaneous public tasks in the eight-slot stack profile; no full eight-task timing or ordinary publication claim.

local_bundle.scope: Parser comma-group correction; bundled local commit, not asserted published upstream

platform.scope: Queued SIO tests; drive-specific headless MOUNT fixed without changing CPU/peripheral emulation

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

platform.write_delay_basis: Figure 18 (1.0–1.8 ms); qualified only against these pinned disk models. Page 219 prose says 10–18 ms and is not used for these profiles.
platform.timeout_policy: One 250-tick active watchdog: ACK, result and data all inherit its remaining time; receiving a byte does not restart it. No separate phase or per-byte timeout in this disposable probe.

fault_responder.scope: Explicit D8 protocol/stop-bit corruption, test-only environment selector; POKEY and guest execute normally. Includes passive observer and drive-specific MOUNT patches.

bank_zero.accounting: Generated maps; full guards, near arena, table slack and retained legacy contexts; unchanged pools.

fault_scope: Test-only completion overrides after real SIO collection on data sector 5: checksum error 4 or short io_Actual. Physical wire faults are qualified separately in sio-sectors.json.

limits.operation_scheduling: One complete DOS operation; round-robin mount queues between operations.
